author: cskiraly
content: I would argue the DNS is part of our resilience, and wouldn't sunset it. Even for discv4, it will stay active in forks for quite long. We just want to make sure Ethereum mainnet itself is upgraded to support discv5 is both EL and CL, and that all clients could tap into this.

author: deme1744
content: I agree that it’s good to have a secondary mechanism like this (or something similar) around in case discovery network gets attacked somehow. It would still allow peering to continue for some time with the nodes already there. I’ve considered in the past adding it but never got to that.
